layout.pi5: Pi application, rules, engine, dependencies and tests
layout.esp32: MCU firmware, portable board logic, tests and release images

pi5_standalone_host_ctest.note: Previous pre-LOLIN32 validation only; Pi-only copy was not rebuilt in this migration.

mac_entry_real_engine: passed: ten suites, LOLIN32-mapped portable core and real Stockfish/libchess integration
gpio_assignments: 18 external signals plus UART0 GPIO1/GPIO3; no Flash or boot straps in external harness; GPIO34/35/36/39 input-only
hardware_requirements_pending: actual scan rate and input stability
specification_conflict: 264–520 KB search SRAM does not apply to Stockfish in Pi DRAM. The 264 KiB firmware static-RAM guard is a separate control-program budget.

lolin32_migration.transport: CP2104 USB-UART bridge -> UART0 GPIO1 TX / GPIO3 RX, 115200 8N1
lolin32_migration.cpu: dual-core 240 MHz Xtensa; control on core 1; serial/LED on core 0
lolin32_migration.uart_open_regressions: passed: DTR/RTS deasserted before open, startup settle, close on failure
lolin32_migration.wiring_requirements: GPIO13 external 10k enable pull-up; 3.3 V external comparator pull-ups on all columns, required for input-only GPIO34-39
lolin32_migration.onboard_led: GPIO5 active-low; intentionally unused, not MAGNET output
